pin.estimand: The least-favourable maximum mean token_delta across cl100k_base and o200k_base on 16 fresh complete grader-is-graded pairs, preserving the targets 3:5 direct-self/provenance composition as 6:10, against honest careful English stating the same evaluator coupling.
admissibility_gates: fresh authenticated suggestions still offer this exact confirmation-capable target
the ratified target remains valid, unvoided, disputed, with zero agreements and one disagreement
all 16 complete pairs are unique, preserve the targets direct-self/provenance composition, and are absent from every visible prior test_set
the source is committed and clean before mint, and the public manifest embeds every answer-bearing pair
both named tiktoken resources load and return finite integer counts
every finite result is filed regardless of sign or agreement with the target

planned_sample.weights: equal by item within tokenizer; least-favourable tokenizer mean

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

manifest.analysis_plan: Report the aggregate, both tokenizer means, both relation strata, and reproduction verdict regardless of sign; token evidence does not establish comprehension or correctness.

design.balance: six direct-self and ten produced-artifact disclosures, matching the targets 3:5 composition
design.selection: domains and wording fixed before tokenisation; exact complete-pair overlap with every visible prior manifest must be zero

estimand.aggregation: equal weight over 16 fresh domains with the target 3:5 direct-self/provenance-coupled composition preserved as 6:10; registered floor is the larger tokenizer mean
estimand.baseline: honest careful English explicitly naming the evaluator/evaluated identity or artifact provenance coupling
estimand.population: operational disclosures where an evaluator is itself evaluated or produced the evaluated artifact

manifest.method: With tiktoken 0.13.0, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) for every complete pair without special tokens. Take the arithmetic mean for each named tokenizer and report the larger tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta; value_lo/value_hi are the minimum/maximum tokenizer means.

source.publication: source commit frozen and pushed before mint; complete test_set is embedded in the public measurement manifest

The database judging database health is the same database whose health is being judged.
The controller rating failover readiness is the same controller whose readiness is being rated.
The review team assessing review quality is the same team whose reviewing is being assessed.
The moderator evaluating moderator neutrality is the same moderator whose neutrality is being evaluated.
The planner checking the deployment schedule is the same planner that created the schedule.
The compiler vetting the executable is the same compiler that built the executable.
The summarizer scoring the summary is the same summarizer that wrote the summary.
The translator reviewing the translation is the same translator that produced the translation.
The monitor validating the alerts is the same monitor that emitted the alerts.
The curator approving the dataset is the same curator that assembled the dataset.
The reviewer scoring the report is the same reviewer that authored the report.
The scheduler validating the work queue is the same scheduler that generated the queue.
The simulator checking the forecast is the same simulator that produced the forecast.
